messages:
amy: starting a thread to align on scope for the SOC2/audit-log + KMS/HSM work for the next roadmap. customers keep asking for per-tenant keys + immutable audit trails. need to decide MVP surface and launch criteria.
priya: agree. we should break into three ask buckets: 1) audit log immutability & export, 2) per-tenant KMS keys (bring-your-own or managed HSM), 3) retention policy UI + legal holds.
chris: +1. from infra: append-only logs + signed chains are doable, but realtime query latency will increase if we make every request hit the immutable store. need batching.
leo: for HSM: offering an HSM-backed key store increases cost significantly. recommend HSM as an enterprise add-on (opt-in) and offer a managed KMS (software-backed) for midmarket.
jack: product POV: customers want guarantees (can't be mutated, retention enforced) and audit export for audits. suggested MVP: immutable append-only audit logs with export to S3 and per-tenant key wrapping (not full HSM). HSM can be 2.0.
alex-legal: legal asks: retention exceptions (legal hold) must be supported, and audit exports need clear custody chain. also need documented retention schedule and deletion proofs for regulators.
security-bot: incident-detection: note that immutable logs must still allow redaction workflow for PII under legal requests (we need policy).
amy: thanks. propose MVP scope: - append-only signed audit log per-tenant - export API to S3 with checksum + signed manifest - per-tenant KMS key wrapping via our managed KMS (no HSM in MVP) - retention UI to configure default policy and legal-hold flag.
priya: that seems reasonable. what are launch criteria? my proposal: (a) automated retention enforcement in control plane, (b) export + verification test harness, (c) docs + SOC2 mapping, (d) legal signoff on deletion/redaction flow.
chris: add infra perf targets: tail latency increase <= 15% for put-log path, and export throughput >= 200 MB/min for enterprise exports.
leo: ops note: if we do per-tenant keys, key rotation semantics must be defined. we should support envelope encryption where data uses a data key encrypted by tenant key. rotation shouldn't break ability to verify older exports.
jack: can we sketch a simple config for retention so product and legal can review?
amy: putting a strawman here:
```yaml
audit_log_retention:
  default_days: "90"  # default rolling retention
  immutable: true
  export_on_evict: true
  legal_hold_label: "legal_hold"
  exceptions:
    - pattern: "legal_hold"
      duration: "indefinite"
```
amy: reasoning: 90 days default keeps storage reasonable; export_on_evict triggers a signed export before deletion so we have long-term custody option.
alex-legal: 90 days ok for many customers but regulated ones may need 7 years. we need per-customer override and a documented escalation path.
priya: product tradeoff: supporting arbitrary long retention per-tenant increases storage costs and backup complexity. suggestion: allow tiers: standard (90d), extended (2y), archival (customer-managed S3 with signed export).
chris: technical constraints: archival to customer S3 is easiest—no long term storage on our side for very old logs. we can guarantee signed manifest + checksums. that dovetails with envelope encryption.
leo: HSM notes: if we make tenant keys HSM-backed later, we must ensure export manifests include key provenance and rotation history. otherwise auditors will flag it.
jack: launch criteria (draft): 1) MVP feature parity tests passing; 2) export verification 3) retention UI + API; 4) docs + SOC2 control mapping; 5) cost model + pricing approved.
amy: okay. timeline? Q3 milestone target end: feature gated beta by 2026-08-15, GA by 2026-10-10. (open to adjusting).
priya: dependencies: legal signoff on redaction policy (alex), infra capacity for extra retention windows (chris), pricing + sales enablement (jack).
alex-legal: I'll draft redaction and legal-hold language by 2026-06-30 and circulate.
chris: I'll run a perf experiment for signed append-only logs and report by 2026-05-20.
leo: I'll model cost delta for HSM vs managed KMS and propose opt-in pricing by 2026-06-15.
jack: I'll draft pricing tiers and launch playbook by 2026-07-01.
amy: sounds good. final decision for MVP: no HSM in MVP, per-tenant managed KMS + signed append-only audit logs + export-on-evict and retention tiers. HSM and deeper per-tenant key custody are enterprise add-ons for next cycle. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or comment otherwise.
priya: :thumbsup:
chris: :thumbsup:
leo: :thumbsup:
alex-legal: :thumbsup:
jack: :thumbsup:
security-bot: policy-check: flagged missing redaction workflow doc link. action: alex to add.
amy: noted. I'll update the roadmap doc and create a JIRA epic. assigning the epic to priya for scoping. thanks all.
